svg.text: W8 · First run: the first time the editor opens (proposed)
A new Tessera has 4 tracks and a demo clip, but no output module, so Play makes no sound. The editor says so and fixes it in one click.
Make a sound in three steps
Patch its V/OCT and GATE into a voice (VCO → VCA with an envelope).
Press Space. The demo clip plays.
It goes away by itself once a track has an output.
Demo clip — press Space to hear it once Track 1 has an output
Hollow output dots on every track: nothing is listening. Hover: "No output module
plays this track. Click to add one."
"Add Track Out" places a Track Out right of Tessera (or the nearest free spot), bound
to Track 1, as one undo step. The same action is on every hollow dot and in the Track
The card lives in the empty timeline, not in a pop-up: it never blocks editing and
Device strip closed (just the "Devices" chip): a new user sees notes first, not an
Empty and silent states explain themselves where the eye already is. The panel display
says the same in one line: "No output: add a Track Out" (W5).
